messages.subject: including external script in Addin
parts:
I'm working on a package of Addins and have got to the point where I would like to include external JavaScript code.  I try to acces the file

inst/www/js/custom.js

using a call like this:

tags$head(tags$script(src = "www/js/custom.js"))

but the app cannot locate the file.  (It does show up in the Web inspector in the correct way as <script src = "www/js/custom.js">).

What would be the correct path for an installed package of addins?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: including external script in Addin
parts:
One option is to include it directly in the page:

includeScript(system.file("path-in-inst-to-file.js", package="your-package"))

Another is to map the inst/www directory to a URL. You can do this with addResourcePath (try to pick a URL prefix that isn't likely to clash with other package authors). I'm on my phone now so I won't include an example here but let me know if you need one.

The reason the way you tried it didn't work (even without www in your script tag, as Mortensen quite reasonably suggested) is because the automatic mapping of the "www" dir to the / URL path only works when you call runApp with a directory. For addins/gadgets this generally won't be the case. Since Shiny doesn't know what directory the app code comes from it doesn't know anything about www directories. So you need to map the directory to a URL manually with addResourcePath.

messages.subject: Re: including external script in Addin
parts:
I tried both Morten's suggestion and Joe's `includeScript(system.file())` suggestion.  Both worked to locate the file.

What I've actually done is to develop a custom input element.  The problem with file-location arose when I was following the directions in the Shiny article on custom inputs.  However, even after locating the js file, R can't recognize the new input.  Interestingly, if I insert the js code direcltly, i.e.:

```
myOwnTextInput <- function ...

code <- HTML("<script> contents of the js file </script>")

ui <- miniPage(
     code,
     myOwnTextInput("info","Write Here"),
...
```

then everything is fine.  But of course that's a separate issue from the one I raised earlier.
